description: Class representing a pivot table field item.

GetCaption.description: Returns a caption of the pivot item.

GetName.description: Returns a name of the pivot item.

GetParent.description: Returns a parent of the pivot item.

GetValue.description: Returns a name of the specified item in the pivot table field.

GetVisible.description: Returns the visibility of the pivot item.

returns.description: True if the pivot item is visible, false otherwise.

SetVisible.description:
Sets the visibility of the pivot item.
<note> At least one item must remain visible when hiding others. </note>

params.description: Specifies whether the pivot item is visible.
params.name: visible
